prose: Homie Romie of the Rising From The Ashes Podcast blesses us with an original presentation of his antiquated transhumanism thesis. In the first segment we discuss the mechanics of human-to-ether cloud consciousness and the possible tools used to achieve it from the ancient world, taking an extensive look at the royal crowns.
Music in this episode: "Doobie Snack" by Homie Romie.
ext: Our exploration expands to dowsing rods and the hidden divining tools & techniques of the alchemical initiates. We also look at other royal devices, such as scepters, swords, the globus cruciger, bells, and other magical talismans.
